## Public record

Each issue stores its forecast, empirical interval, learned weight curves, calibration
cutoffs, data vintage, and input contributions. The repository retains the dated files for
later verification against the gauge.

- [Dated forecasts](https://github.com/jcblsn/gsl-forecast/tree/main/forecasts)
- [Model source](https://github.com/jcblsn/gsl-forecast/tree/main/src/forecasting)
- [USGS gauge 10010000](https://waterdata.usgs.gov/monitoring-location/10010000/)
